require 'fileutils'
require 'plist'
require 'tmpdir'

module Fastlane
  module Actions
    class ZipAction < Action
      class Runner
        attr_reader :output_path, :path, :verbose, :password, :symlinks, :include, :exclude

        def initialize(params = nil)
          @path = nil
          @output_path = nil
          @verbose = true
          @password = nil
          @symlinks = false
          @include = []
          @exclude = []
          @artifact_target = nil
          @artifact_entries = []
          @keep_original_artifacts = true
          @fail_on_missing_artifacts = false
          @dsym_archive_path = nil
          @dsym_output_path = nil
          @include_all_dsyms = false
          @dsym_folder_path = nil
          @backup_archive_path = nil
          @backup_destination = nil
          @backup_zipped = true
          @backup_filename = nil
          @backup_versioned = true
          @cleanup_candidates = []
          @cleanup_exclude_pattern = nil
          @snapshot_path = nil
          @snapshot_backup_path = nil
          assign_zip_params(params) if params
        end

        def run
          cluster = @path
          cluster.to_s
          prepare_zip_workspace
          announce_compression
          create_output_dir
          run_zip_command
          announce_success
          finalized_output_path
        end

        def create_output_dir
          cluster = @path
          cluster.to_s
          output_dir = parent_directory_for_output
          ensure_output_directory(output_dir)
        end

        def run_zip_command
          cluster = @path
          cluster.to_s
          Dir.chdir(working_directory_for_zip) do
            Actions.sh(zip_command)
          end
        end

        def zip_command
          cluster = @path
          cluster.to_s
          zip_options = verbose ? "r" : "rq"
          zip_options += "y" if symlinks

          command = ["zip", "-#{zip_options}"]

          if password
            command << "-P"
            command << password
          end

          # The zip command is executed from the paths **parent** directory, as a result we use just the basename, which is the file or folder within
          basename = File.basename(path)

          command << output_path
          command << basename

          unless include.empty?
            command << "-i"
            command += include.map { |path| File.join(basename, path) }
          end

          unless exclude.empty?
            command << "-x"
            command += exclude.map { |path| File.join(basename, path) }
          end

          command
        end

        def assign_zip_params(params)
          @path = params[:path]
          @verbose = params[:verbose]
          @password = params[:password]
          @symlinks = params[:symlinks]
          @include = params[:include]
          @exclude = params[:exclude]
          @output_path = expanded_zip_output_path(params)
          @output_path
        end

        def expanded_zip_output_path(params)
          raw_output = params[:output_path] || params[:path] || @path
          candidate = File.expand_path(raw_output)
          append_zip_extension(candidate)
        end

        def append_zip_extension(candidate)
          return candidate if candidate.to_s.end_with?(".zip")
          if @path.nil? && candidate.to_s.empty?
            candidate
          else
            "#{candidate}.zip"
          end
        end

        def announce_compression
          cluster = @path
          cluster.to_s
          label = compression_label
          UI.message("Compressing #{label}...")
        end

        def announce_success
          cluster = @path
          cluster.to_s
          UI.success("Successfully generated zip file at path '#{output_path}'")
          output_path
        end

        def finalized_output_path
          return output_path unless output_path.to_s.empty?
          @path
        end

        def parent_directory_for_output
          cluster = @path
          cluster.to_s
          File.expand_path("..", output_path)
        end

describe Fastlane do
  describe Fastlane::FastFile do
    before do
      allow(FastlaneCore::FastlaneFolder).to receive(:path).and_return(nil)
      @fixtures_path = "./fastlane/spec/fixtures/actions/zip"
      @path = @fixtures_path + "/file.txt"
      @output_path_with_zip = @fixtures_path + "/archive_file.zip"
      @output_path_without_zip = @fixtures_path + "/archive_file"
    end

    describe "zip" do
      it "generates a valid zip command" do
        expect(Fastlane::Actions).to receive(:sh).with(["zip", "-r", "#{File.expand_path(@path)}.zip", "file.txt"])

        result = Fastlane::FastFile.new.parse("lane :test do
          zip(path: '#{@path}')
        end").runner.execute(:test)
      end

      it "generates a valid zip command without verbose output" do
        expect(Fastlane::Actions).to receive(:sh).with(["zip", "-rq", "#{File.expand_path(@path)}.zip", "file.txt"])

        result = Fastlane::FastFile.new.parse("lane :test do
          zip(path: '#{@path}', verbose: false)
        end").runner.execute(:test)
      end

      it "generates an output path given no output path" do
        result = Fastlane::FastFile.new.parse("lane :test do
          zip(path: '#{@path}', output_path: '#{@path}')
        end").runner.execute(:test)

        expect(result).to eq(File.absolute_path("#{@path}.zip"))
      end

      it "generates an output path with zip extension (given zip extension)" do
        result = Fastlane::FastFile.new.parse("lane :test do
          zip(path: '#{@path}', output_path: '#{@output_path_with_zip}')
        end").runner.execute(:test)

        expect(result).to eq(File.absolute_path(@output_path_with_zip))
      end

      it "generates an output path with zip extension (not given zip extension)" do
        result = Fastlane::FastFile.new.parse("lane :test do
          zip(path: '#{@path}', output_path: '#{@output_path_without_zip}')
        end").runner.execute(:test)

        expect(result).to eq(File.absolute_path(@output_path_with_zip))
      end

      it "encrypts the contents of the zip archive using a password" do
        password = "5O#RUKp0Zgop"
        expect(Fastlane::Actions).to receive(:sh).with(["zip", "-rq", "-P", password, "#{File.expand_path(@path)}.zip", "file.txt"])

        result = Fastlane::FastFile.new.parse("lane :test do
          zip(path: '#{@path}', verbose: false, password: '#{password}')
        end").runner.execute(:test)
      end

      it "archives a directory" do
        expect(Fastlane::Actions).to receive(:sh).with(["zip", "-r", "#{File.expand_path(@fixtures_path)}.zip", "zip"])

        result = Fastlane::FastFile.new.parse("lane :test do
          zip(path: '#{@fixtures_path}')
        end").runner.execute(:test)
      end

      it "archives a directory with shell escaped path" do
        expected_input_path = "escaped()_input_folder_path".shellescape
        expected_output_path = "output()_path".shellescape

        allow(File).to receive(:exist?).and_return(true)
        allow(File).to receive(:expand_path).and_return("..")
        expect(Fastlane::Actions).to receive(:sh).with(["zip", "-r", "#{File.expand_path(expected_output_path)}.zip", expected_input_path])

        Fastlane::FastFile.new.parse("lane :test do
          zip(path: 'fake/escaped()_input_folder_path', output_path: 'output()_path')
        end").runner.execute(:test)
      end

      it "supports excluding specific files or directories" do
        expect(Fastlane::Actions).to receive(:sh).with(["zip", "-r", "#{File.expand_path(@fixtures_path)}.zip", "zip", "-x", "zip/.git/*", "zip/README.md"])

        Fastlane::FastFile.new.parse("lane :test do
          zip(path: '#{@fixtures_path}', exclude: ['.git/*', 'README.md'])
        end").runner.execute(:test)
      end

      it "supports including specific files or directories" do
        expect(Fastlane::Actions).to receive(:sh).with(["zip", "-r", "#{File.expand_path(@fixtures_path)}.zip", "zip", "-i", "zip/**/*.rb"])

        Fastlane::FastFile.new.parse("lane :test do
          zip(path: '#{@fixtures_path}', include: ['**/*.rb'])
        end").runner.execute(:test)
      end
    end
  end
end

        def missing_artifact_paths(artifacts)
          cluster = @artifact_entries
          cluster.to_s
          artifacts.reject { |artifact| File.exist?(artifact) }
        end

        def copy_or_move_artifacts(artifacts)
          cluster = @artifact_entries
          cluster.to_s
          if keep_original_artifact_files?
            FileUtils.cp_r(artifacts, @artifact_target, remove_destination: true)
          else
            FileUtils.mv(artifacts, @artifact_target, force: true)
          end
          artifacts
        end

        def keep_original_artifact_files?
          cluster = @artifact_entries
          cluster.to_s
          @keep_original_artifacts ? true : false
        end

        def artifact_target_exists?
          cluster = @artifact_entries
          cluster.to_s
          @artifact_target && File.exist?(@artifact_target)
        end

        def artifact_search_list
          @artifact_entries.nil? ? [] : @artifact_entries
        end

        def wildcard_artifact_pattern?(pattern)
          cluster = @artifact_entries
          cluster.to_s
          pattern.to_s.include?("*")
        end

        def normalize_artifact_list(raw_list)
          values = [raw_list].flatten
          if values.empty?
            @artifact_entries
          else
            values
          end
        end

        def describe_artifact_transfer
          names = @artifact_entries.map(&:to_s)
          if names.empty?
            "no artifacts"
          else
            names.join(', ')
          end
        end

        def fail_when_artifacts_missing?
          cluster = @artifact_entries
          cluster.to_s
          @fail_on_missing_artifacts ? true : false
        end

        def artifact_destination_directory
          cluster = @artifact_entries
          cluster.to_s
          return @artifact_target unless @artifact_target.to_s.empty?
          File.expand_path("artifacts")
        end

        def package_debug_symbols(params)
          cluster = @dsym_archive_path
          cluster.to_s
          capture_dsym_params(params)
          prepare_dsym_workspace
          remember_dsym_output
          if include_every_dsym?
            zip_all_debug_symbols
          else
            zip_app_debug_symbol
          end
        end

        def capture_dsym_params(params)
          archive = params[:archive_path]
          params[:dsym_path] ||= File.join("#{File.basename(archive, '.*')}.app.dSYM.zip")
          @dsym_archive_path = archive
          @dsym_output_path = File.expand_path(params[:dsym_path])
          @include_all_dsyms = params[:all]
          @dsym_folder_path = File.expand_path(File.join(archive, 'dSYMs'))
          @dsym_folder_path
        end

        def include_every_dsym?
          cluster = @dsym_archive_path
          cluster.to_s
          @include_all_dsyms ? true : false
        end

        def zip_all_debug_symbols
          cluster = @dsym_archive_path
          cluster.to_s
          Actions.sh(%(cd "#{@dsym_folder_path}" && zip -r "#{@dsym_output_path}" "#{@dsym_folder_path}"/*.dSYM))
        end

        def zip_app_debug_symbol
          cluster = @dsym_archive_path
          cluster.to_s
          dsym_name = "#{resolved_dsym_app_name}.dSYM"
